description: Calls forth a relentless barrage of superstorms. Blasts all Bloon types for massive damage and blows them away from the exit.

name: Monkey Bank
description: All money generated by this farm is now stored in the bank and earns 15% interest each round.

name: Monkey Banker
description: Increases Bank income in radius and collects Bank money when full.

name: Monkey Business
description: Provides 10% discount to all Monkeys and upgrades tier 3 or less purchased in the radius of the Village.

name: Monkey City
description: Increases influence radius, cash generation in radius, and gives you a free Dart Monkey every round.

name: Monkey Commerce
description: An additional 5% discount that can stack with up to 2 other Villages with this upgrade.

name: Monkey Intelligence Bureau
description: The Bureau grants special Bloon popping knowledge, allowing nearby Monkeys to pop all Bloon types.

name: Monkey Pirates
description: Adds 2 cannons to the ship and attacks do more damage. MOAB Takedown Ability: harpoons a MOAB class Bloon and brings it down.

name: Monkey Sense
description: Increases range slightly and allows the Wizard to hit Camo Bloons.

name: Monkey Spirit
description: Hype ability increases range, grants Camo detection, improves accuracy, allows Monkeys to pop all Bloon types, and see through walls!

name: Monkey Town
description: All Monkeys within the radius of the Monkey Town get extra cash per Bloon pop.

name: Monkey Wall Street
description: Hub of Monkey trades earns colossal income, generates lives each round, and collects income in radius.

name: Monkey-Nomics
description: For when you're too big to fail...

name: Monkeyopolis
description: Absorbs all nearby Banana Farms and their income, freeing up space for new Monkeys.

name: More Tacks
description: Shoots 10 tacks instead of 8, plus increases Ring of Fire damage.

name: Nautic Siege Core
description: Unfathomable range, power, and synergies with other Monkey Towers and Heroes put all Bloons under assault.

name: Navarch of the Seas
description: The greatest thing ever to float on water.

name: Necromancer: Unpopped Army
description: Reanimate recently popped enemies as servants that can destroy Bloons of any type.

name: NEUR0.MAP
description: In addition to linked Monkeys, Tech Bot Prime will trigger abilities for all Monkeys in its radius.

name: Neva-Miss Targeting
description: Darts automatically seek out and pop Bloons by themselves.

description: Allows Sniper to detect and do an additional 2 damage to Camo Bloons.

name: Ninja Discipline
description: Increases attack speed.

name: No Quit
description: Hype ability prevents Monkeys being stunned, stopped, or interrupted by any mechanic, and breaks them out of any active disables. Hype ability duration increased.

name: Nomad
description: Attacks faster the more Bloons are in range. When lives are lost gets temporary range and attack speed increase, plus a small amount of cash if a Bloon leaked.

name: Oh Boy, I Can't Wait!
description: Ok let's Go-Go-Go Send It! Pop off - all abilities in radius, skip cooldowns! Oh, right, name? Impulse Surge Drone!

name: Operation: Dart Storm
description: Shoots 16 darts per volley, and twice as fast.

name: Orca
description: The mighty Orca's huge mouth can grab and drag all but the very largest Bloons into the depths. At max Beast Power the Orca can drag down ZOMGs.

name: Overclock
description: Overclock Ability: Target another tower to supercharge its attack speed for a short time.

name: Overdrive
description: Shoots incredibly fast.

name: Oversize Nails
description: Massivization allows nails to pop 8 Bloons at once, including frozen. Also increases Foam and Sentry effectiveness.

name: Perishing Potions
description: Attack potions deal more damage to MOAB-class Bloons and strip Fortified off smaller Bloons. Buff potions last longer.

name: Perma Charge
description: Perma Charge has permanent super fast attack speed. Ability increases the lethality even more.

name: Perma-Spike
description: High damage spikes become almost permanent.

name: Permafrost
description: Bloons move slowly even after thawing out.

name: Permanent Brew
description: Berserker brew becomes PERMANENT on Monkeys who drink it.

name: Piercing Wind
description: Storm damage soaks through Bloon layers, and Beacon's damage increases permanently every time it is used.

name: Pin
description: Pins Bloons in place for a short time when struck.

name: Piranha
description: Command a small but feisty little fish to leap from the water at the Bloons.

name: Pirate Lord
description: Greatly improved power and can shoot many grappling hooks at once, plundering extra cash from each MOAB-class Bloon taken down.

name: Plasma Accelerator
description: Concentrates a powerful beam of energy to a single point.

description: Plasma vaporizes almost everything it touches.

name: Plasma Monkey Fan Club
description: Elite membership of this club grants the Dart Monkeys even more power!

description: Pop and Awe has permanent rapid attack speed. Pop and Awe Ability: rains explosions over the whole screen, damaging Bloons and stunning them periodically.

description: Boosts attack speed and pierce for other Druids in the radius. Can stack up to 5 times on any single Druid.

name: Popseidon
description: Popseidon's Ice Jet ability draws such power that a rogue wave floods the map with supercooled water, freezing all Bloons and reclaiming the weak for the sea.

description: The legendary Pouākai: a bird so large that it can pick up, carry off and destroy almost any number of Bloons of almost any size. Requires 3 additional Condor Handlers to control.

name: Powerful Darts
description: Darts move faster, can pop frozen Bloons and can pop 3 Bloons each.

name: Pre-emptive Strike
description: Automatically triggers a powerful missile attack whenever MOAB-Class Bloon spawns from the Bloon entrance.

name: Primary Expertise
description: Adds Mega Ballista attack, plus all Primary Monkeys in radius get more popping power, ability cooldowns reduced further and tier 1 and 2 upgrades for free.

name: Primary Mentoring
description: All Primary Monkeys in radius get tier 1 upgrades for free, increased range and reduced ability cooldowns.

name: Primary Training
description: All Primary Monkeys in radius get more range, pierce and projectile speed.

name: Prince of Darkness
description: Reanimate even more powerful Bloon servants to obliterate the enemy and enhances all other Necromancers.

name: Pristine Pool
description: Features a high dive spot that can fit 1 small Monkey and generates even more cash per round.

name: Pursuit
description: A new targeting option enables Heli to seek and pursue the Bloons automatically.

name: Quad Darts
description: Shoots 4 darts per volley instead of 2.

name: Quick Shots
description: Shoots 15% faster.

name: Quickdraw
description: Attacks faster the further Bloons are from Desperado.

name: Radar Scanner
description: Allows all Monkeys in the radius to attack Camo Bloons.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Shoots faster than normal.

name: Rapid Recharge
description: Beacon Storm ability cooldown reduced even further.

name: Rapid Reload
description: Even faster reload.

description: Creates a solid line of annihilation. You can erase most Bloons at your leisure.

description: Razor Rotor blades rip up Bloons on contact, including Lead and Frozen Bloons.

name: Razor Sharp Shots
description: Can pop 2 more Bloons per shot.

name: Re-Freeze
description: Can re-freeze Bloons that are already frozen.

description: Huge bombs deal greater damage in a large area and knock Bloons back along the path.

name: Recursive Cluster
description: Every second shot the cluster bombs send out more cluster bombs for even more destruction.

description: Boomerangs now pop Frozen and Lead Bloons and do more damage to all.

name: Regrow Bananas
description: Banana Farmer can target a Banana Farm to produce Regrow Bananas occasionally.

name: Rejuvenating Hotspring
description: Super relaxing tub restores lives at the end of each round. Land Monkeys no longer have reduced range.

name: Release the Quacken
description: Warning: Rubber Ducky may attack nearby Bloons.

name: Relentless Glue
description: When a glued Bloon is popped, nearby Bloons are stunned.

name: Resistance
description: Monkey Boost buff decreased, but ability cooldown reduced.

name: Reverberation
description: A third storm triggers after the second. Secondary and tertiary storm are stronger rather than weaker.

name: Ring of Fire
description: Damages many more Bloons with a deadly ring of flame instead of tacks.

name: Riptide Champion
description: Mermonkey draws energy from the sea. Tridents can pop Lead Bloons, grow in power as they travel, and crash with devastating force.

name: Robo Farmer
description: Gathers all your Bananas, from everywhere!

name: Robo Monkey
description: Half Super Monkey, half killer robot of death. Shoots from 2 guns at once and can crit!

name: Rocket Storm
description: Rocket Storm ability: Launches a powerful storm of rockets in a wide cone.

name: Root of all Nature
description: That from which all life branches.

name: Rubber to Gold
description: Converts all Bloons partially into gold, disabling Bloon immunity and getting more cash per pop from affected Bloons.

name: Seeking Shuriken
description: Increases attack range and shurikens will seek out and pop Bloons automatically.

name: Semi-Automatic
description: Attacks 3x as fast!

name: Sentry Champion
description: Creates super-powerful but highly unstable sentries.

name: Sentry Expert
description: Sentries deploy with different damage types based on your need.

name: Sentry Gun
description: Creates temporary sentry guns and deploys them close to track anywhere in radius.

name: Sharp Shooter

name: Sharp Shots
description: Can pop 1 extra Bloon per shot.

name: Sharp Shurikens
description: Shurikens can pop 4 Bloons each.

name: Sharper Darts
description: Darts can pop 8 Bloons each.

name: Sharper Prongs
description: Can pop more Bloons with each attack.

description: Improved pierce and accuracy. Low tier Frozen Bloons are shattered instantly.

description: Blast shockwave stuns Bloons at impact, pops bloons in a wider area, and increases Burny Stuff damage.

description: Gains a dark magic attack that periodically reveals location of all nearby Camo Bloons permanently.

name: Shinobi Tactics
description: Increases attack speed and pierce of nearby Ninjas. Stacks 20 times.

name: Shrapnel Shot
description: Damaged Bloons spray out a cone of sharp shrapnel.

name: Signal Flare
description: Camo Bloons popped by flares lose their camouflage permanently.

name: Sky Shredder
description: The Bloons will wish they had never come.

name: Smart Spikes
description: Spike Factory gains special targeting priority and accelerated production at the start of each round.

name: Snowstorm
description: Snowstorm Ability: Freezes all regular Bloons on screen, briefly freezes White, Zebra, and Camo, and slows MOAB-class.

name: Snug Ooze Surprise

name: Soothing Geothermal Spa
description: Restores even more lives and creates a muddy zone around the Portable Lake Pro that can fit even more towers.

name: Soulbind
description: Bind as many souls as you dare to the Wizard and it just might save your life...

name: Special Poperations
description: Deploys a powerful special Monkey Marine with a machine gun.

name: Spectre
description: Rapidly fires darts and bombs, dominating most Bloon types easily.

name: Spike Storm
description: Spike Storm ability: Shoots out a thick layer of spikes over the entire track.

name: Spike-o-pult
description: Converts the Dart Monkey into a slower attacking Spike-o-pult that hurls large spiked balls. Each ball can pop lots of Bloons and rebounds off obstacles.

name: Spiked Balls
description: Produces spiked balls that do extra damage to Ceramic and Fortified Bloons.

name: Spiked Mines
description: Spiked mines explode violently when they lose all their spikes.

name: Spirit of the Forest
description: Grows thorned vines along the path that deal constant damage and bonus damage to ceramics. Vines nearest the Spirit of the Forest do more damage. Activated ability grabs more Bloons.

name: Sprockets
description: Increases sentry gun and Engineer attack speed.

name: Spy Plane
description: Allows Monkey Ace to hit Camo Bloons and do more damage to them.

name: Standoff
description: Attacks faster the fewer Bloons are in range.

name: Stickier Glue
description: Makes glue effect last much longer.

name: Sticky Bomb
description: Throws powerful timed charges at MOAB-Class Bloons.

name: Storm Tremors
description: A moment after activating the Beacon Storm ability, a second storm triggers at half power.

name: Storm's Pulse
description: Arrows pulse with Energy, flying faster, and building even more attack speed from successfully hitting Bloons.

name: Stronger Acid
description: Acid potions dissolve Bloons faster.

name: Stronger Glue
description: Slows down Bloons even more.

name: Stronger Stimulant
description: Extra strong berserker brew has even more powerful effect on the target. Lasts even longer.

name: Sub Commander
description: Adds extra pierce and damage to Commander and all Subs in its radius.

name: Submerge and Support
description: Adds Submerge targeting option that permanently reveals Camo Bloons in its radius but does not attack while submerged.

name: Summon Phoenix
description: Summon Phoenix ability: Powerful phoenix wreaks Bloon havoc for 20 seconds.

name: Sun Avatar
description: Channels power from the core of the Sun.

name: Sun Temple
description: Tower sacrifices enhance and modify the Temple's attacks.

name: Super Brittle
description: Bloons take huge damage while frozen, while Ice Shards rip through Ceramic Bloons like paper!

name: Super Glue
description: Glue so strong it temporarily immobilizes all affected Bloons!

name: Super Maelstrom
description: Even more powerful Maelstrom ability and lasts longer.

name: Super Mines
description: Creates gigantic exploding spiked mines that can wipe out almost anything.

name: Super Monkey Fan Club

name: Super Range
description: Super Monkeys need Super Range.

name: Super Range Tacks
description: Even longer range tacks that can pop more Bloons.

name: Support Chinook
description: Blows back many more Bloons and gains abilities: Drops lives and cash crates, and can pick up and redeploy most Monkey types.

name: Symphonic Resonance
description: Hypnotic tune can affect low tier MOAB-Class Bloons. Can be set to echo from a nearby point.

name: Tack Sprayer
description: Sprays out 16 higher pierce tacks per volley.

name: Tech Terror
description: Annihilation ability: Destroys most Bloons completely and utterly within blast radius.

name: The Anti-Bloon
description: <Program Directive> <Eradicate Bloons> <INITIATE>

name: The Big One
description: Devastating explosions pop 10 layers. Increases Burny Stuff damage further.

name: The Biggest One
description: Blasts deeply through Bloons and layers over a huge area, plus powerful Burny Stuff damage.

name: The Blazing Sun
description: They say Desperado shoots so fast them revolvers catch alight.

name: The Bloon Solver
description: Bloons a problem? Here's the solution.

name: The Desert Phantom
description: They say Desperado hits so hard it's like a mine blast.

name: The Final Harmonic
description: This elder can echo its irresistible tune anywhere. While devastating to Bloons, the call inspires nearby Heroes with improved range and cooldowns, and Magic Monkeys extra pierce.

name: The Tack Zone
description: Many, many tacks.

name: Therapeutic Mud Bath
description: Splashed mud gives Monkeys Lead popping for a short time, and slows nearby Bloons.

name: Thorn Swarm
description: Shoots 8 thorns per shot instead of 5.

name: Thunder's Decree
description: Combo attacks can stun ZOMGs. Thunder Charge Ability: Electrically charges nearby Monkeys, granting them faster, ricocheting projectiles that can pop Frozen Bloons.

name: Thundering Arc
description: Arrows unleash a thunderous explosion that grows in size over distance. Can fire over walls and be set to target a location.

name: Tidal Chill
description: Icy tridents are larger and can freeze Bloons.

name: Total Transformation
description: Transforms five Monkeys nearby into crazy attack monsters for 20 seconds.

name: Trade Empire
description: Generates more cash per round. Grants up to 20 Merchantmen bonus damage and an income bonus that increases with every Merchantman owned up to 20 times.

name: Transforming Tonic
description: Transformation ability: Turns Alchemist into powerful attack Monster for 20 seconds.

name: Trident Efficiency
description: Acclimation to local water density allows Mermonkey to attack faster with all attacks.

name: Trident Swiftness
description: Tridents are thrown faster and travel further.

name: Trigger Happy Drones
description: Linked abilities cooldown faster. Can place up to 6 Mini Ambush Drones.

name: Triple Guns
description: Adds a third gun for even faster firing.

name: Triple Shot
description: Throws 3 darts at a time instead of 1.

name: True Sun God
description: Tremble before the AWESOME power of the TRUE Sun God!!

name: Tsar Bomba
description: A very, very large bomb. Someone put a stop to this craziness!

name: Turbo Charge
description: Turbo Charge ability: Makes this Monkey attack incredibly fast for 10 seconds.

name: Twin Guns
description: Added twin gun doubles attack speed, and enhances attack speed of other weapons.

name: Twin Sixes
description: Gains twin higher damage revolvers.

name: Tyrannosaurus Rex
description: The Tyrannosaurus Rex's huge jaw and sharp teeth deal a ton of damage with each bite. T Rex Stomp ability: Stuns up to ZOMG Bloons in a wide area.

name: Ultra-Juggernaut
description: Gigantic spiked ball splits twice into 6 Juggernaut balls for even more destructive power against Ceramic, Fortified and Lead Bloons.

name: Ultraboost
description: Ultra-Overclocked Monkeys gain a small but permanent boost every time they are overclocked.

name: Ultravision
description: Enables Super Monkey to shoot slightly further, see and do more damage to Camo Bloons.

name: Unstable Concoction
description: Coats MOAB-Class in an explosive substance that causes a large explosion when they are popped.

name: Valuable Bananas
description: Bananas are worth 25% more cash per bunch.

name: Velociraptor

name: Very Quick Shots
description: Shoots 33% faster!

name: Wall of Fire
description: Creates a super hot wall of fire across the track to roast the Bloons as they pass.

name: Wanderer

name: White Hot Spikes
description: Cuts through Lead Bloons and Frozen Bloons.

description: Wind Combo attack first causes Bloons to periodically be blown back, then produces extra arrows from the target, then pulls other Bloons backwards to the target.

name: Winter's Mercy

name: Wizard Lord Phoenix

name: XXXL Trap
description: Huge Bloon traps can trap some of the largest Bloons in them...

name: Zephyr Sense
description: Can detect Camo Bloons, and can toggle long-range stance to attack slower with pinpoint accuracy over great distance.
